mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_lot ( user_seq, currency_type, amount, remaining, expire_date, status, source ) VALUES ( #{userSeq}, #{currencyType}, #{amount}, #{remaining}, #{expireDate}, #{status}, #{source} )
mapper.select: SELECT lot_seq AS lotSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, currency_type AS currencyType, amount, remaining, expire_date AS expireDate, status, source, reg_date AS regDate FROM wallet_lot WHERE lot_seq = #{lotSeq}

SELECT lot_seq AS lotSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, currency_type AS currencyType, amount, remaining, expire_date AS expireDate, status, source, reg_date AS regDate FROM wallet_lot WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND currency_type = #{currencyType} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_date >= #{today} AND remaining > 0 ORDER BY expire_date ASC

SELECT lot_seq AS lotSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, currency_type AS currencyType, amount, remaining, expire_date AS expireDate, status, source, reg_date AS regDate FROM wallet_lot WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND currency_type = #{currencyType} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_date >= #{today} AND remaining > 0 ORDER BY expire_date ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT currency_type AS currencyType, COALESCE(SUM(remaining), 0) AS balance FROM wallet_lot WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_date >= #{today} GROUP BY currency_type
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_lot SET status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE lot_seq = #{lotSeq} AND status = 'USED' AND remaining > 0
UPDATE wallet_lot SET remaining = remaining + #{amount}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE lot_seq = #{lotSeq}
UPDATE wallet_lot SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_date < #{today}
mapper.select: SELECT user_seq AS userSeq, currency_type AS currencyType, expire_date AS expireDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM wallet_lot WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining > 0 GROUP BY user_seq, currency_type, expire_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT lot_seq AS lotSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, currency_type AS currencyType, amount, remaining, expire_date AS expireDate, status, source, reg_date AS regDate FROM wallet_lot WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND currency_type = #{currencyType} AND expire_date = #{expireDate} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY lot_seq ASC

SELECT lot_seq AS lotSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, currency_type AS currencyType, amount, remaining, expire_date AS expireDate, status, source, reg_date AS regDate FROM wallet_lot WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_date >= #{today} AND remaining > 0 ORDER BY currency_type, expire_date ASC
